title: Aaron Glenn names Geno Smith the starter: He's our guy

sources.title: Jets' Glenn: 'No doubt' that Smith is starting QB
sources.description: Jets coach Aaron Glenn on Sunday became the first person from the organization to publicly declare Geno Smith as the starting quarterback, saying, "he's our guy."
